Hero.Title: Mergers & acquisitions advisory
Hero.Description: We guide Swiss founders, family businesses and investors through buy-side and sell-side transactions with disciplined process management, valuation expertise and post-deal integration support.

Presentation.Title: Practical M&A support for Swiss companies
Presentation.Subtitle: Preparing, negotiating and closing transactions with confidence
Intro: Ark Fiduciaire delivers hands-on M&A advisory across French and German speaking Switzerland. We shape deal strategy, prepare financial models, coordinate due diligence and lead negotiations so you can stay focused on the business.

Our team covers the key searches people use when planning a deal — Swiss M&A advisory, company valuation, buy-side due diligence, sell-side preparation, private equity exits and succession planning. We translate that demand into a clear roadmap tailored to your objectives.
We leverage transaction data, market comparables and management insights to secure terms that reflect the true value of your company while protecting founder interests.
Presentation.PartnerNote: For legal structuring, SPA drafting and regulatory filings we work hand in hand with our trusted law firm partners.
Services: Buy-side and sell-side mandates, including target screening and process management
Financial modelling, scenario planning and independent company valuation
Vendor and buy-side due diligence coordination across finance, tax and HR streams
Deal negotiation support covering letters of intent, SPA terms and closing checklists
Post-merger integration planning with a focus on finance, payroll and reporting setups
Succession and carve-out projects for Swiss SMEs seeking a smooth handover

Strengths.Title: Local mid-market focus
Strengths.Desc: We understand how Swiss owners, cantonal authorities and domestic lenders approach M&A so we can anticipate issues early.

Strengths.Title: Integrated specialists
Strengths.Desc: Accounting, tax and payroll experts join the project team so operational risks and earn-out mechanics stay under control.

Strengths.Title: Regulatory awareness
Strengths.Desc: Experience with FINMA notifications, SECO approvals and cross-border data sharing keeps transactions compliant.

Strengths.Title: Pragmatic reporting
Strengths.Desc: We deliver concise memos, data room trackers and negotiation briefs so decision makers stay aligned throughout the process.
